teaser.text: Tencent Holdings Limited is a Chinese technology company that sells digital entertainment, advertising, payments and business technology. Its services reinforce one another because people use the same digital environment to communicate, consume content, shop and work.

stock.title: Tencent Holdings Limited stock forecast through 2029
stock.meta_description: Tencent Holdings Limited stock forecast: weighted, bear and bull scenarios, the cash test, key drivers, and valuation in plain English.
stock.opening: The weighted scenario reaches HKD575.73 in October 2029, including dividends. It hinges on AI returns.
stock.closing: The full memo also explains Tencent Holdings Limited’s business, rivals, management, and risks.

blocks.heading: Where could Tencent Holdings Limited’s shares go?

paragraphs.text: The forecast's central outcome is a gradual rise, not an immediate re-rating. The weighted price reaches HKD433.24 in October 2027 and HKD575.73 in October 2029, including dividends. The intervening estimate is HKD487.03 in October 2028.
At the final date, the bear case is HKD292.57 and the bull case is HKD880.88, against today's HKD424.80. The range reflects uncertainty over AI returns, cash conversion and valuation confidence.

blocks.heading: What has to go right for Tencent Holdings Limited?

paragraphs.text: The bear case is HK$292.57 with 25% probability. The bull case is HK$880.88 with 20% probability. The remaining 55% is the base case. The path depends on established businesses growing while AI monetization gradually offsets investment. Toward year-end 2026 and into 2027, GPU and ASIC capacity—chips for the heavy calculations that train and run AI—must become paid external cloud and model demand, with utilization and cash conversion improving. Through 2027–2029, game launches need licensing, retention and spending, while Channels must deliver advertiser returns without weakening engagement.

EBITDA is the main operating choice. Base EBITDA rises from RMB385,000 million to RMB480,000 million; the bear case falls from RMB340,000 million to RMB380,000 million; the bull case rises from RMB400,000 million to RMB550,000 million. The base reflects H1 growth of 8.6%, continued advertising and games growth, and analyst revenue estimates, while AI investment restrains margins. The bear assumes weak utilization and softer advertising or games. The bull requires repeat AI demand and profitable cloud capacity.

blocks.heading: How much cash does Tencent Holdings Limited really make?

paragraphs.text: Share-based pay deserves a separate deduction. It does not use cash immediately, but it transfers economic value to employees. Subtracting it from free cash flow produces a more demanding measure of what the business generated for existing owners. That measure recovered in 2025, although its margin remained below the earlier level because Tencent was committing more money to assets and infrastructure.

dividend.title: Tencent Holdings Limited dividend: pay and coverage
dividend.meta_description: Tencent Holdings Limited pays a rising dividend, but AI investment puts pressure on cash coverage.
dividend.opening: Tencent's base forecast raises dividends from RMB6.20 to RMB8.20 per share, while the bear case holds at RMB6.00 and the bull case reaches RMB10.00. Its cash coverage is under pressure: reported free cash flow was negative RMB13.8 billion in June 2026, although it would have been positive RMB37.6 billion without compute-procurement prepayments.
dividend.closing: The full memo also examines Tencent Holdings Limited's business, rivals, management decisions and risks.

blocks.heading: How much does Tencent Holdings Limited pay in dividends?

paragraphs.text: Base dividends rise from RMB6.20 to RMB8.20 per share. The bear case holds at RMB6.00, while the bull case reaches RMB10.00. The base is below the recent growth rate because infrastructure needs cash, but five consecutive annual increases and management's stated dividend direction support continued growth. Recent negative free cash flow explains the bear possibility.

blocks.heading: Is Tencent Holdings Limited's dividend covered by its cash?

paragraphs.text: June 2026 showed why timing matters. Operating cash flow was RMB52,710 million. Reported free cash flow was negative RMB13.8 billion, but Tencent said it would have been positive RMB37.6 billion without compute-procurement prepayments. The cash genuinely left the bank account; it simply bought future capacity before Tencent consumed it. The next test is whether that capacity generates profitable AI or cloud revenue.

Disposals and purchases of investments also flowed through a common pool. Tencent sold assets, bought others and retained substantial cash, but it did not publish a transaction-by-transaction map linking each disposal cheque to a later use. The next test is AI. Management expects buybacks to decline as computing infrastructure receives more funding, while dividends rise. That makes the choice explicit: shareholder returns have already delivered value, and some investments now earn profits, but the enlarged AI programme still has to justify its cost.

blocks.heading: What is Tencent Holdings Limited's dividend yield today?

paragraphs.text: Cash gives a second test. The free-cash-flow yield is 5.5%, while the dividend yield is 1.2%. Tencent also repurchased about HK$80 billion of shares in 2025 and HK$24.4 billion in the first half of 2026. Prosus, a Tencent shareholder, sells existing Tencent shares while Tencent cancels repurchased ones, so buybacks reduce the share count but do not eliminate all market supply.

earnings.title: Tencent Holdings Limited earnings date and guidance
earnings.meta_description: Tencent Holdings Limited's next results are expected November 10, 2026; AI investment will more than double, while growth faces a heavier spending burden.
earnings.opening: Tencent Holdings Limited's next results are expected on November 10, 2026. The key thing to watch is whether purchased computing becomes billable capacity.
earnings.closing: The full memo also answers questions about Tencent Holdings Limited's business, rivals, management and risks.

blocks.heading: What has Tencent Holdings Limited guided for 2026?

paragraphs.text: The company wants games, advertising, payments and business services to finance Hy models, the Yuanbao assistant, WorkBuddy for office work and CodeBuddy for programming. Its March 18, 2026 guidance says investment in new AI products will more than double during the year ending December 2026. That is a spending commitment, not a promise about revenue, profit or return.

blocks.heading: Did Tencent Holdings Limited keep its past promises?

paragraphs.text: Tencent also made and broadly met large repurchase commitments. It committed to more than HK$100 billion in March 2024, then at least HK$80 billion in March 2025. At the August 2026 results call, James Gordon Mitchell said higher expected returns from computing investment could shift cash from buybacks to capital expenditure.

blocks.heading: What were Tencent Holdings Limited's last eight reported periods?

paragraphs.text: Revenue grew 11.0%, while operating income grew 11.9%. Domestic games benefited from Delta Force, VALORANT and Roco Kingdom: World. International games declined in reported currency but grew at constant exchange rates, showing how currency translation can obscure underlying customer demand. Advertising and FinTech and Business Services also expanded.

blocks.heading: What should investors watch in Tencent Holdings Limited's next results?

paragraphs.text: Management expects enough GPU and ASIC capacity—specialized chips designed for particular tasks—toward year-end 2026 and into 2027 to expand external cloud rentals and model services. Investors should look for rising customer use, improving operating cash and prepaid capacity that stops expanding faster than revenue.
